# Jane Davenport

> A creative learning platform offering in-person art retreats, online workshops, and mixed-media courses led by artist Jane Davenport.

Jane Davenport's website features a comprehensive catalog of art education products including stand-alone workshops, bundled packages, and immersive retreats. The site specializes in mixed-media techniques, watercolor painting, drawing, and creative skill-building for artists of all levels.

## Art Retreats & In-Person Experiences

- [Jane Davenport Art Retreats](https://janedavenport.com/product-category/art-retreats): Jane Davenport's in-person art retreats and creative workshops

## Online Workshops & Courses

- [Online Workshop Menu! - Jane Davenport](https://janedavenport.com/product-category/stand-alone-workshops): Catalog of Jane Davenport's online art workshops and courses
- [Stamp to Story Workshop | Sketch without drawing! - Jane Davenport](https://janedavenport.com/courses/inkvincible-stamp-to-story): Stamp to Story mixed-media workshop with techniques and lessons
- [Windswept & Wuthering Watercolour Workshop - Jane Davenport](https://janedavenport.com/shop/supplies/new/windswept-wuthering-watercolour-workshop): Watercolour painting workshop with portrait and mood techniques

## Workshop Bundles & Packages

- [Workshops Packages - Jane Davenport](https://janedavenport.com/product-category/workshops-packages): Bundled workshop packages and discounted art education sets
